crossRefs.note: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, “Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are…

parallels.note: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.
One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”

translations.web: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, “Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you.”
translations.bsb: and a crowd was sitting around Him. “Look,” He was told, “Your mother and brothers are outside, asking for You.”
translations.kjv: And the multitude sat about him, and they said unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.
translations.asv: And a multitude was sitting about him; and they say unto him, Behold, thy mother and thy brethren without seek for thee.
